1.texto_original: ¶ Ora let suwi, kadung wong-wong sing nurut Gusti Yésus mundak okèh, terus ènèng karépotan nang tengahé wong Ju sing ngomong Grik karo wong Ju sing ngomong Ibrani. Sing dadi jalaran edum-edumané duwit kanggo nulungi para mbok randa ing saben dinané. Wong-wong Ju sing ngomong Grik pada kelah nèk para randané pada kekurangan, awit ora nampa bagèan sing sak mestiné.

"Mengkono kuwi wong-wong mau marakké gègèran nang tengahé wong-wong kono lan uga nang tengahé para pinituwa lan para guru Kitab. Stéfanus terus dikroyok lan dityekel, terus digawa nang ngarepé Kruton Agama."

The original language presents significant lexical and syntactic elements. Key terms reveal theological distinctions often lost in translation.

Historical-Critical Context

Source criticism and form criticism illuminate the compositional history. The Sitz im Leben reflects socio-religious dynamics of antiquity.

Theological Implications

This verse contributes to covenant theology, divine sovereignty, human responsibility, and eschatological hope.

Archaeological Evidence

Recent discoveries from the ancient Near East provide material context for interpreting this passage.
